component.name: SD Sync Immich
component.summary: Upload new photos from a camera card to Immich

description.p: Insert your camera's SD card and SD Sync Immich uploads only the new photos and videos to your Immich server. No more remembering which shot you uploaded last.

ul.li: Starts uploading by itself when the card is inserted
Remembers what each card has uploaded: next time only the new shots go up
Shows the card's photos by day while they upload
No duplicates: checks the file date and checksum
Photos, RAW and video with XMP sidecars; RAW+JPEG pairs are stacked as one photo
Ejects the card when done and, if you like, formats it once every file is checked in Immich

description.p: Needs an Immich server and an API key. Not affiliated with the Immich team.
